question: The perimeter of equilateral triangle is 3*(sqrt[4]{(16)/(3)}) units. Determine the area of the triangle.
solution:
**Given:**

Perimeter of equilateral triangle = 3 ×(sqrt[4]{(16)/(3)}) 

**Formula used:**

Perimeter of equilateral triangle = 3 × side

Area of equilateral triangle = (√3/4) × (side)²

**Calculation:**

Perimeter of equilateral triangle = 3 ×(sqrt[4]{(16)/(3)})
